name: Henry Ying-tung Fok
profile: Hong Kong tycoon (Fok Ying Tung Group; property, shipping, construction) and Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee from 1993 until his death in Beijing on 28 October 2006.
notes: Died 28 Oct 2006. Sources: https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/200610/29/P200610290098_print.htm ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Henry_Fok. Family business continues under the Fok family (e.g. Henry Fok Estates / Fok Ying Tung Group).

name: Kanichiro Ishibashi
profile: Eldest son of Bridgestone founder Shojiro Ishibashi; Bridgestone president 1963-1973, then chairman and honorary chairman. Born 1 March 1920 in Kurume; died 30 June 1997 aged 77.

name: Laurence Alan Tisch
profile: Co-founder with brother Bob Tisch of Loews Corp.; CEO of CBS 1986-1995. Died of cancer on 15 November 2003 aged 80.
notes: Died 15 Nov 2003. Sources: https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/wbna3475179 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laurence_Tisch. Loews is now led by son James Tisch.

name: Liang Zhaoxian
current_role: Chairman & President, Galanz Group (also chairman of Whirlpool China since 2021)
profile: Son of Galanz founder Liang Qingde, he joined the family firm in 1991 and took over as executive president in 2000, steering Galanz from a 1978 feather-products plant in Shunde/Foshan into one of the world's biggest microwave makers, then into air conditioners and small appliances. In 2021 Galanz took control of Whirlpool China, which he chairs.
interesting_fact: Galanz began in 1978 as a feather (duck down) products plant before pivoting to microwave ovens; it now makes roughly half of the world's microwaves.
deep_cut_fact: Before joining Galanz he graduated from South China Institute of Technology (now SCUT) in 1987 and that same year founded his own international trading company in Hong Kong, Zhanbang Enterprise (展邦企业); he later took MBA courses in Hong Kong in 1990.
notes: Press email is Galanz Americas' Marketing/PR contact (US subsidiary), not the Foshan HQ. Whirlpool China (惠而浦中国, SSE 600983) is a listed vehicle with a board secretary/IR route. Title is reported variously as chairman/president/CEO.
